evidence: In the TTIP/NH3 process, nitrogen (N2) was used as carrier and purge gas with a flow rate of 40 and 60 sccm during the titanium precursor pulse for the TTIP/NH3 and TDMAT/N2 processes, respectively. During the nitrogen pulse, flow rates of 144 sccm of NH3 (TTIP/NH3) and 265 sccm of N2 (TDMAT/N2) were used.
